study: Open every %R turn on the desk's own quality names, with the live exits. Does cutting the losers with the live stop and letting the winners run with trail_dc and the ratchet turn the turn entry into a profit?
registered_at: 2026-10-19, before any replay of these arms was run.
origin: Operator 2026-10-19: 'Open all possible names that have a %R turn, and have the exits stop the bad ones and let the good ones run.' Not unscreened names: the names must be quality (momentum, catalyst, the desk's sources). 'No volume, no trade.'
prior_evidence: Stated before the run. prescreen_turn (2026-10-17): the same turn on 400 unscreened liquid names a session fires a median 9 minutes before the desk's fills and is a random minute at a 10-minute hold (-0.2 bp, t -1.17, n 283,456). right_tail_runner (2026-10-15): a 2% stop with a trail after +1% on the desk's own fills, net -11.0 / -17.2 bp per trade. knob_replays (2026-10-14): loosening the arm gates added opens and loss (-66 to -222 bp/day). The expected result is a per-trade net near minus the spread. This test is different from all three: the live exit stack, run by the live code, on the live board.
the_turn: ai_watch_exh_any_turn_arm (ai_entry_watch._any_turn_allows_buy), off live. A turn read on the live indicator row: pctr_rising and pctr_slow_rising both true on this reading and on the previous reading the check saw (the onset), fast %R at or below -70 at a reading in the last 600 s that came after the previous arm ended (a new dip each time), fast %R at or below -40 now. Armed for 60 s from the onset; fast %R falling or the 60 s running out ends the arm. Only readings that reach the exhaustion check are remembered, not polls refused earlier by the spread, gap, structure or source gates. It is modelled on the prescreen BOTHUP rule but reads the live row's rising flags, not two completed bars, so it is not the same rule. When on it is the only exhaustion lane.
names: Quality names are the desk's own board: the replayed live code seats names from the recorded source lists (momentum, movers, catalyst/research boards, tight, trending) through the live admission rules ($10 floor, spread gate, admission RVOL, stale-quote and stream-price guards). Nothing is added to the board for this test.
volume: No volume, no trade (operator). Every live volume gate stays on: admission ai_watch_min_rvol 1.0, ai_watch_movers_min_rvol, ai_watch_tight_min_rvol, ai_watch_trending_min_rvol, the arm RVOL floor ai_watch_arm_min_rvol 0.45 (time-adjusted), and ai_watch_heating_min_rvol 1.25 where it applies. None is relaxed.

arms.live: The whole live config of the replayed commit, pinned (--set-json), with only the profiler off. Square and empty-square arms, trail_dc, the 15 s ratchet leash, 5 positions. The reference.
arms.turn5: live plus ai_watch_exh_any_turn_arm=true and ai_watch_presquare_only=false (live refuses every last-mode arm that is not the empty square, which would refuse every turn). No admission setting is changed (the RSI-2 cap is admission-only and stays at 65), so nothing is added to the board. 5 positions, 20% each, as live. Cheap band, pace, spread, stale quote and the RVOL floor stay as live.
arms.turn20: turn5 with ai_max_positions=20 and ai_max_position_pct=5: open every turn the book can hold, not only the first five.

exits: The live exit stack, run by the live code in the replay (tools/replay_session.py --exits live): the initial stop, the local trail with trail_dc (ai_trail_exit_trend_hold, band 0.05%), the ratchet leash (ai_local_trail_decay_idle_sec 15), T1 scale, dead trade, and the 15:50 flatten. Not changed by any arm.
sessions: The recorded live sessions 2026-10-06, 07, 08, 09, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16 (9 sessions; the exit sweep's 8 plus 10/16). Half A: 10/06-10/09. Half B: 10/12-10/16. A session whose recording is missing or whose replay fails for any arm is left out for every arm and counted; the run is UNDERPOWERED with fewer than 8 scored sessions.
cost: Net bp per trade = return - the full SIP quoted spread at entry (replay_costing.entry_spread_bp), charged once. Two price lines: (1) the replay's fill at the recorded dashboard price, which can be stale; (2) a SIP re-price, entry at the SIP 1-minute open after the entry time and exit at the SIP 1-minute open after the exit time, same spread. Both lines are required by the words. Broker stop slippage (about 7 bp) is not simulated; a net minus 7 bp on stop and trail exits is printed. A net with synthetic-row opens left out is printed. VALUE (bp per day) weights each trade by its position size, pct / 20: turn20's 5% positions count a quarter of live's 20%.
call: Per turn arm. PASS: on both price lines, net per trade > 0 in both halves with day-clustered t >= 2 over all scored sessions; and weighted VALUE above live in both halves with paired t >= 1.5, on the dashboard-price line and on the SIP re-price. PROMISING (project tier): on both price lines, net per trade > 0 in both halves with t >= 1.5. FAIL otherwise. UNDERPOWERED: fewer than 8 scored sessions or fewer than 100 trades. The score refuses if a turn arm has no turn-lane opens (arm_why any_turn / last_any_turn) on a scored session, or any open from another lane. Money only follows a PASS and a forward paper period.
what_is_printed: Per arm, all sessions and each half: trades, net per trade (t) on the dashboard-price line and on the SIP re-price, net minus 7 bp on stop exits, net without synthetic opens, weighted VALUE per day (t), the minimum detectable effect, seats. Paired weighted VALUE vs live per half. Opens per day vs the recorded live fills. Exit-reason counts. SIP re-price misses per arm (trades left out of the SIP lines).
no_retuning: The turn definition (-70 dip within 600 s, -40 early, 60 s arm), the three arms, the sessions, the halves, and the cost are fixed. Another turn or another gate is a new prereg.
command: On the mini, after 16:15 ET, after a result-skeptic Mode 1 READY on this prereg and its code, from a clean tree at the commit that carries the lane: TH_DATA_SECRETS=$PWD/secrets_data.json nohup bash scripts/turn_open_sweep.sh > /tmp/turn_open_run.log 2>&1 &   It replays, then scores with tools/studies/turn_open_score.py (SIP bars from the data-only account). No config edit; the lane stays off live.
power: Nine sessions (halves of 4 and 5). The minimum detectable day-mean at t = 2 is printed per arm (2 x day SD / sqrt(sessions)); a FAIL does not rule out a per-trade edge smaller than that. This is a test of a large effect on the desk's own names, not of a small one.
known_differences: In the turn arms a seated name waiting for a turn blocks as wait_turn, which is not a never-armable code, so it is not evicted after 30 s the way live evicts names that never arm; the turn arms can keep a different book. Seats per day are printed per arm. Replay opens are printed next to the recorded live desk's fills per day (replay recall of live was about 0.7 on 10/13).
amendment_2026-10-19: Result-skeptic Mode 1 NOT READY before any replay. Fixed: the RSI cap override dropped (admission-only); SIP re-price line required; VALUE weighted by position size; turn-lane open check; turn onset, cancel and new-dip rule; BOTHUP equivalence no longer claimed; MDE; synthetic-free net; seats and recorded-live opens printed.
